featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is very good and helpful. If you have any doubts, you can ask without hesitation—the staff is really supportive. I visited for my fresh passport application, and I had forgotten to bring Xerox copies of some documents. Luckily, there was a Xerox machine available on-site, so I could get copies without any hassle.

The process is very smooth if you have all your documents ready.

Tip: If you have an appointment, just arrive about 15 minutes early. There’s no need to come an hour in advance. Even if you’re 5–10 minutes late, it’s usually not a problem—they are quite helpful and will assist you.

featured_reviews.name: Yashvi Gavankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in Wagle Estate near the industrial area, this Passport Seva Kendra runs in a fairly organized manner. You can arrive before your slot time, though your registration number is still tied to your slot and processed in ascending order.

The A section is quick and efficient. However, in the B section, even though there is a seating area, the staff makes you stand, which creates unnecessary crowding. The same happens in the C section, making it feel congested and suffocating at times.

One important point: before leaving the office, the security person insists you fill out the feedback form. It seems that the more feedback he collects, the better bonus he receives, so you cannot exit without completing it.

A useful tip: ensure you already have valid documents and keep your Digilocker with Aadhaar card ready on your mobile phone. This saves time and avoids last-minute hassles.

My work was completed within 30 minutes, and on the same day I received a message from my nearest police station regarding verification.

Overall, the process was smooth and efficient, though crowd management in B and C sections and the forced feedback requirement could be improved.

featured_reviews.name: Tanmay Thakare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently applied for a Tatkal passport and had a great experience at PSK II Thane. This was the first time I witnessed such a fast and smooth government service process. My entire verification was completed within just 15–20 minutes.

The staff was extremely helpful and polite. The office was also very clean, well-maintained, and organized. Overall, I’m very impressed with the efficiency and professionalism here.

Suggestions for applicants:

Carry a printout of your application.

Keep self-attested copies of all documents along with the originals.

Fetch your Aadhaar and PAN through DigiLocker.

Carry the Tatkal undertaking form.

For reference, I carried: Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, and Birth Certificate.

Highly recommended for anyone applying for a passport at Thane!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had planned a vacation for my wife and son to Japan.  As a family, our schedules doesn’t allow us to plan in advance. So to ensure we get a visa at the earliest , I decided to go through an agent.After checking with close friends who travel a lot , I was referred to STP . I was given the number of a senior person. He didn’t pick up my call and contacted me through WhatsApp. He just send me the contact details of one of his associates.

No one bothered to check with me on my travel profile , my reference. That was the basic step for any service business

The associate had no idea other than sending me a checklist. In the first conversation , I explained that my travel dates are fixed and it is non negotiable.  He assured me that they will get the visa organised. Even though he put all his efforts , it was very clear that he had no one to guide him at the backend. It took them 2 weeks to submit our documents.

1. It operates like a sweatshop. The owners have the experience but have left running the business to juniors. There is no option to escalate .
2. After we collated all the  documents , it took them 2 days to accept it as the email id’s they shared was not working . It was clear they still haven’t had their tech sorted.
3. Every query took 24 to 48 hours for them to come back to us and resolve.  Their was no co-ordination with their back office
4. Even after submitting our documents , till the last day , they could not provide us any update on the status.
There was absolutely zero proactive updates provided.
5.  Our plan was to leave on 12th of October , they just informed us about the visa on 12th morning.

In this entire 2 weeks , not a single person other than the junior associate communicated with us. Even during the last days , other than texting , the senior person whose name is mentioned on their website as one of the management team whose reference I received didn’t even bother to speak to me.

In the end we had to cancel our Japan trip.

This happened after we got a reference from an existing client.  I even went through their website and could only manage to get the twitter id of the founder. I send him an escalation message on hos twitter
No one responded. imagine you contact them through Google or as an unknown client.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Saji,
Thank you for sharing your feedback and concerns with us. We understand your situation and have reviewed it internally to ensure it’s addressed.

We’re truly sorry for the inconvenience caused and assure you this isn’t the experience we strive to deliver at StampThePassport. We genuinely value your input and are already working on enhancing our customer service.

We hope to have an opportunity to serve you better in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Ali Azar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Misleading claims and unprofessional communication.

This company advertises itself as a Dubai Government authorised agent, yet my visa process was handled through a third party, with no official UAE government acknowledgment shared for the first three days.

Despite repeated follow-ups, there were:
•	No official links
•	No timestamps
•	No verifiable proof that the application had been initiated

On day four, a senior executive/co-founder stepped in, but instead of documentation, I was given vague explanations like “in talks with PRO” and “stuck in security”, without any written evidence.

What I found most concerning was the unprofessional, emotionally charged communication, including statements such as “we are waking up all night to solve this for you” and “do you want me to talk with you and get your visa done?” — which is not how a professional immigration service should operate.

If you are considering this company, ask very clearly who actually processes your visa and insist on official proof at every stage
